name: PTO 功能验证标准 v0

execution.pypto_source: hw-native-sys/pypto language Tensor/Tile API; locked compiler and runtime in data/upstream.lock.json
execution.operator_inputs_and_weights: random; real checkpoint payloads are introduced during integration
execution.physical_buffer_capacity: evaluated during later storage and architecture mapping

activation_quantization.scope: BF16 activations consumed by FP8 GEMM only
activation_quantization.amax_formula: max(abs(x.float())) over valid elements of each group
activation_quantization.data_scale_association: preserve corresponding groups and rows through reorder, gather and dispatch

fp8_gemm.scale_application: apply matching activation and weight scales to each K-group contribution

comparison.reference: independent reference using the same functional profile
comparison.acceptance: every element must pass; average error does not determine acceptance
comparison.quantization_error: record separately from implementation error against the same-profile reference

topk.reference_method: organize inputs by ascending expert ID, stable-sort scores descending, then take the first K
topk.origin: project_convention; not an assertion about torch.topk tie ordering

moe_dispatch.slot: retain when needed to identify the original Top-K position
moe_dispatch.tail_rows: respect each expert's valid count Ne
moe_dispatch.combine: accumulate every routed contribution exactly once at its original Token
moe_dispatch.concrete_field_layout: specified with the shared Dispatch/Combine implementation

implementation_status: specification recorded; implementation and validation evidence tracked per OP/K and case
